The '''Salfrem system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within [[the Wastes]], a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. One of its [[Planet/Legends|planets]], known as [[PL-40112-CE-021105]], was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Bertroff Hissa]].
